senses.gloss:
Sobhari is the name of a ṛṣi frequently mentioned in the Rigveda. The family is also referred to, and a father, Sobharī.
Foot notes viii. 5, 26; 19, 2; 20, 19; 22, 2.
Rv. viii. 19, 32; 20, 8.
Rv. viii. 22, 15. Cf. viii. 103, 14; Av. xviii. 3, 15.
Cf. Ludwig, Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 105; Oldenberg, Zeitschrift der Deutschen Morgenländischen Gesellschaft, 42, 217.
